corrections.text: Despite its title, RECALL PROCEDURE CODES is not limited to recallable codes on this report: any procedure code can be chosen.
corrections.evidence_quote: Any code can be chosen, not only recallable ones

corrections.text: ALL = every completed procedure code, which makes a very long report.
corrections.evidence_quote: `RECALL PROCEDURE CODES` | Codes to include; `ALL` = every completed code (very long report).

corrections.text: PROCEDURE DATE RANGE is matched on the date the procedure was completed.
corrections.evidence_quote: `PROCEDURE DATE RANGE` | Date the procedure was completed (`Proc. Date`).

corrections.text: TRANSACTION PROVIDER is the provider on the ledger line of the completed procedure.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Transaction Provider` | Provider on the ledger line of the completed procedure.

corrections.text: Hidden population rule with no criteria control: accounts marked for collection (Send to Collection) are left out of the report. The vendor article concerns the procedural recall report; the document states the rule for all four recall reports.
corrections.evidence_quote: Accounts marked for collection are excluded from all recall reports

corrections.text: SCHEDULED DATE RANGE filters on the date of the scheduled appointment, not on the recall due date.

corrections.text: PREFERRED PROVIDER and PREFERRED HYGIENIST filter on the patient's preferred provider / hygienist from Patient Information.
corrections.evidence_quote: The patient's preferred provider / hygienist from Patient Information.

corrections.text: Scheduled / Not Scheduled is evaluated per recall code: a patient with two of three codes scheduled still lists for the third.
corrections.evidence_quote: Evaluation is per code: with two of three codes scheduled, the patient still lists for the third

unresolved.question: What happens to the From / To boxes when Age Range is unticked? Not documented (the same row exists on Scheduled Recall Report and Recall Due Report).

Is the RECALL PROCEDURE CODES list limited to recallable codes on Scheduled Recall Report and Recall Due Report? The document states only that any code can be chosen on Procedural Recall Report and that ALL means every recallable code on Recall Due Report.
What does No Recall Date select - presumably patients without any recall due date (unverified) - and what happens to Start Date / End Date when it is chosen?

The document says accounts flagged Send to Collection are excluded from ALL recall reports, but the vendor article it cites is about the procedural recall report. Confirm the exclusion on Scheduled Recall Report, Recall Due Report and Post-Op Report.

Picker dialogs this document does not describe (it refers to legacy_report_outputs_daily_my.md for the picker dialogs): Transaction Provider, Preferred Provider, Preferred Hygienist, and the layout of the Recall Procedure Codes and Exclude Patient Type dialogs - for the last two only the value domain is given.

The Office / Office Group semantics and the UPDATE MY FAVORITES relabel are stated by the document as cross-cutting facts for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens and are recorded once, on Procedural Recall Report. Confirm that they hold on every report screen of the category.

Rights: the vendor lists the security right Reports - Recall Reports Screen in two variants, Full Control and View Only (view only = see the report list and the parameters, cannot generate). How View Only shows on the criteria screen (PRINT / PREVIEW hidden or disabled?) is not described, so no rule is recorded.
